definitions.gloss: such, that kind of, like that
definitions.explanation: Refers to something near the listener or something just mentioned in conversation. Part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system.

examples.japanese: そんなこと⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
そんな⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand such difficult problems.

examples.japanese: そんな⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
そんな⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧もの⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{買|か}えない→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧？
examples.english: I can't buy something that expensive. Is there anything cheaper?

examples.japanese: そんな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧しないで。⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't make a face like that. I'm just joking.

notes:
そんな is part of the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system, referring to things near the listener or things just mentioned.

KO-SO-A-DO PATTERN:
- ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧: this kind of (near speaker)
- そんな: that kind of (near listener/just mentioned)
- ⟦あんな→あんな：01574_anna⟧: that kind of (far from both)
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧: what kind of (question)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- そんな⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: That's not true
- そんな⟦はず→はず：01557_hazu⟧は⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: That can't be
- そんな⟦{馬鹿|ばか}→馬鹿：03574_baka⟧な: That's ridiculous

DERIVED FORM: ⟦そんなに→そんなに：01646_sonnani⟧ (to that extent)
